question: Which country won the FIFA U-20 World Cup 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ukraine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• After defeating South Korea 3–1 in the final, Ukraine secured their first FIFA U-20 World Cup.
